README – Dataset cabrera_22_23_habitat.csv
1. General description

This dataset contains information on plant–pollinator interactions collected in Cabrera during the 2022–2023 field campaigns. Data were obtained through direct observations and automatic camera recordings across different habitats. Each row corresponds to a sampling event (census of pollinator visits to flowering plants).

2. File contents

Format: CSV (semicolon-separated values ;)

Encoding: UTF-8

File included: cabrera_22_23_habitat.csv

Variables (columns)

visita – Visit number (identifier of the sampling visit).

censo – Census number within the visit.

COMMUNITY – Community or site identifier.

habitat – Habitat type (e.g., pine forest, shrubland).

Start_T – Start time of the census.

End_T – End time of the census.

Delta_T_minutes – Duration of the census in minutes.

Plant sp – Plant species observed.

N open flowers – Number of open flowers at the time of census.

N observed flowers – Number of flowers observed during the census.

Pollinator – Pollinator species or morphogroup recorded.

Family – Taxonomic family of the pollinator.

Functional group – Functional group of the pollinator (e.g., bees, flies, butterflies).

N ind – Number of individuals recorded.

N visit flowers – Number of flowers visited.

Method – Sampling method (e.g., direct observation, automatic camera system).

Island – Island where the census was conducted.

3. Data format

Separator: ; (semicolon)

Decimal notation: . (dot)

Missing values: coded as NA
